Career Area: 
Engineering 
 Job Description: 
 
 Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 
 
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
 
 Caterpillar’s EMD division is hiring for Software Development Engineer in Mossville,

 Role Summary: Caterpillar’s Engineering Data Analysis team develops and supports software that helps engineers access, process, visualize, and analyze engineering test and simulation data. DATK and DATK+ are Caterpillar-developed internal engineering data analysis tools, with DATK+ serving as the next-generation platform that integrates multiple analysis capabilities and software components into a unified application. In this role, you will integrate various DATK+ components into a reliable, production-ready application and support the technical infrastructure required to build, test, deploy, and maintain it. You will own the installation-file build and deployment process, support team development and test computers, troubleshoot software, system, and IT-related issues, and automate development workflows to improve team efficiency. As a key technical contributor, you will participate in software architecture discussions, evaluate technical alternatives and trade-offs, and help the team make informed decisions that improve reliability, maintainability, performance, and long-term sustainability.

 What You’ll Do (Job Duties) 
 
• Integrate DATK+ software components developed in Python, C#, C++, and other technologies into a cohesive application; resolve interface, dependency, configuration, compatibility, and performance issues across the integrated system.
• Own and improve the DATK+ installation-file build and deployment process, including installer configuration, dependency packaging, code-signing coordination, security scanning, release verification, documentation, and troubleshooting.
• Identify repetitive or manual development activities and implement automation, engineering tools, and AI-assisted workflows that measurably improve developer productivity, software quality, and delivery efficiency.
• Participate in software architecture and design discussions; evaluate component interfaces, APIs, inter-process communication, dependencies, performance, testability, maintainability, and deployment trade-offs to support informed technical decisions.
• Manage and support team computers in coordination with enterprise IT.
• Diagnose and resolve software, installation, Windows environment, permissions, access, dependency, build-system, network, and other IT-related issues using logs, debugging tools, monitoring tools, and structured root-cause analysis.
• Analyze performance differences across development, integrated, packaged, and installed environments and implement improvements to application startup, execution, and responsiveness.


 What You Have (Core Skills) 
 ·  Technical Excellence: Knowledge of software engineering technologies and application methods; ability to apply strong Python expertise, software architecture principles, cross-language integration techniques, CI/CD, automated testing, and AI-assisted development practices to solve significant DATK+ integration, build, deployment, and development-efficiency challenges.
 · Problem Solving: Knowledge of structured troubleshooting approaches, tools, and techniques; ability to diagnose and resolve complex DATK+ component-integration, installation, performance, dependency, Windows-environment, permissions, access, build-system, and other IT-related problems.
 ·  Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of effective analysis techniques and tools; ability to interpret logs, test results, performance data, and system behavior, determine root causes, compare architectural alternatives and technical trade-offs, and recommend well-informed solutions.
 · Process Management: Knowledge of business and software-process improvement tools and techniques; ability to understand, monitor, automate, control, and improve the team’s integration, build, testing, installation, deployment, computer-support, and development workflows.
 ·  Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding of the precision required to manage software versions, dependencies, interfaces, configurations, permissions, certificates, build artifacts, installation packages, test results, and release documentation to deliver reliable DATK+ releases.
 ·  Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools, and techniques; ability to participate in software architecture discussions, explain technical alternatives and risks, document processes and solutions, and collaborate effectively with developers, testers, users, cybersecurity teams, enterprise IT, suppliers, and global team members.

 Top Candidates Will Also Have 
 Hands-on experience with DATK or DATK+, including software development, architecture, component integration, installation, configuration, testing, or engineering analysis workflows.
 Proven record of applying AI-assisted development tools and techniques in production software workflows, with demonstrated improvements in coding, testing, debugging, documentation, automation, software quality, or developer productivity.
 Experience integrating Python with applications or components developed in C#, .NET, WPF, C++, or other languages using APIs, inter-process communication, shared libraries, or comparable integration approaches.
 Experience creating and troubleshooting Windows installation packages using SetupBuilder, WiX Toolset, Advanced Installer, MSIX, or comparable technologies.
 Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, build agents, artifact and version management, automated testing, code coverage, and software-release practices.
 Knowledge of code signing, software allowlisting, endpoint security scanning, Windows permissions, Program Files constraints, dependency management, and enterprise software-distribution requirements.
 Experience supporting development and test computers, software licenses, build environments, network and access configurations, and internal users in coordination with enterprise IT.
 Experience diagnosing and improving software performance across local development, integrated, packaged, and installed application environments.
 
 Additional Details 
 Work location: Mossville Tech Center
 Domestic relocation assistance IS available for qualified candidates.
 Visa sponsorship is NOT available for this role.
 Travel: Up to 10% domestic and international
 This position requires 5 days per week in the office (M-F)
  
  
  
 
 Summary Pay Range: 
 
$97,530.00 - $146,290.00 
 Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar. 
 
 
 Benefits: 
 Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary list of benefits.
 Medical, dental, and vision benefits*

 Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holidays, Volunteer, etc.)*

 401(k) savings plans*

 Health Lifestyle Programs*

 * These benefits also apply to part-time employees
 
  
  
 
This position requires working onsite five days a week.  
  
Relocation is available for this position.  
  
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.  
  
 
 Posting Dates: 
November 16, 2026 - November 30, 2026 
 Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen.
 
 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities.  Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.
